solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One aiming to make final tried running round circuit?

indicators.note: round says the shuffled letters go around the next piece
running water flows and shifts, so the letters of tried are set moving into a new order

parts.note: a circuit is a ring, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A sprinter who has already run once tries to make the final by going round the track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running' turns TRIED into EDITR; 'round' puts it around O. The definition reads 'make final' as preparing the final version of a text.
explanation.definitionFit: An editor works on copy to produce its finished, final form for publication.

clue.text: Before live broadcast, hope the moon will appear

indicators.note: Before places the reworked letters ahead of the next piece
broadcast scatters seed widely, so the letters of hope are scattered into a new order

parts.note: to live is to be

explanation.surface: A live broadcast awaits the moonrise with hope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns HOPE into PHOE, and 'Before' sets it ahead of BE.
explanation.definitionFit: Phoebe is one of Saturn's moons, also a classical name for the Moon goddess.

clue.text: Wrinkled my wig on riotous date

parts.note: cor! and my! are both exclamations of surprise
rug is slang for a wig or toupee

indicators.note: riotous means wild and disorderly, so the letters of date are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Someone frets that their toupee looks creased before a wild night out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'riotous' turns DATE into ATED. COR is a British exclamation like 'my!'.
explanation.definitionFit: Corrugated means shaped into ridges and furrows, as wrinkled skin or iron sheeting is.

clue.text: Unknown Joe following English about personal representation

parts.note: ff. is the abbreviation for following pages

indicators.note: about says the pair of pieces is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: y is a mathematical unknown
GI Joe is an American soldier, so Joe gives GI

explanation.surface: An anonymous man trails behind an Englishman over a portrait.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns YGI round to IGY, which follows E and FF.
explanation.definitionFit: An effigy is a model or image standing for a particular person.

clue.text: Late example of key praise

parts.note: ex means former, as late can
Alt is one of the keys on a computer keyboard

explanation.surface: A late instance of a musical key gets praised.
explanation.definitionFit: To exalt someone is to glorify them highly.

clue.text: Rum due with African veal dish

indicators.note: rum means odd or strange, so these letters are put into an odd order

explanation.surface: Rum, something owed, and an African link up somehow to a dish of veal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rum' is the British word for odd, not the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Fricandeau is a French preparation of larded, braised veal.

clue.text: To a limited extent, beleaguer ill- advised band member?

indicators.note: only a limited stretch of the following words is used, so the answer sits inside them

explanation.surface: Beleaguering someone is not entirely ill-advised, in a sense.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks 'band' as an armed group of fighters, not musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: A guerrilla fights in an irregular armed group, which can be called a band.

clue.text: Airport reopened legally designated departure area?

indicators.note: reopened says the word opens again in a different way, with its first letter changed

parts.note: Heathrow is London's main airport

explanation.surface: A newly reopened airport has a departure lounge with legal status.
explanation.walkthrough: HEATHROW, London's busiest airport, gets a new opening letter, D. 'departure' is death, so the 'area' is where condemned prisoners wait.
explanation.definitionFit: Death row is the part of a prison where those sentenced to execution are held.

clue.text: Said wise guy regularly shunned — ciao!

indicators.note: every other letter is avoided at regular intervals, so the remaining alternate letters are kept

explanation.surface: Someone said a smart alec was regularly snubbed, and bid him farewell.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the first, third, fifth letters and so on keeps the evens of SAIDWISEGUY.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are words of farewell, French and Italian goodbyes.

clue.text: Get up from seat roughly around lunchtime?

indicators.note: around puts the first piece around the second

parts.note: arse is a coarse word for one's seat or backside
one o'clock is lunchtime, and one is I

explanation.surface: Someone is told to get off their seat at about lunchtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'roughly' marks a crude synonym, not an anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: To arise is to rise or stand up.

clue.text: Means to wipe material linked to online problem

parts.note: toile is a linen or cotton fabric
a troll posts provocative messages on the internet

explanation.surface: A wiping cloth is connected to some internet trouble, perhaps cleaning a screen.
explanation.definitionFit: A toilet roll is paper used for wiping after using the lavatory.

clue.text: Sad start for The Smoke following recession

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter
recession is a going backwards, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a cigar is a smoke

explanation.surface: London's fortunes look sad as an economic downturn follows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Smoke' is a nickname for London, but here 'The' gives its first letter and 'Smoke' a cigar.
explanation.definitionFit: Tragic describes something deeply sorrowful or distressing.

clue.text: Grub up! At last, middle course

parts.note: to rout is to dig up, as a pig roots or grubs up the ground

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A dinner call announces the food at last, a middle course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grub up!' reads as a call to eat, but means dig up.
explanation.definitionFit: A route is the course or way taken to get somewhere.

clue.text: Badly hurt in symmetrically divided battleground? It's entirely logical

indicators.note: in places the second shuffled piece inside the first
ground means crushed, so the letters of battle are ground up
badly says the letters of hurt are put in poor order

explanation.surface: A soldier badly wounded on a battleground split down the middle seems logical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'battleground' splits in half: BATTLE, with 'ground' turning it to TTABLE. 'Badly' makes RUTH from HURT, and 'in' puts it after the first T. 'symmetrically divided' marks the split.
explanation.definitionFit: A truth table sets out every combination of a logical expression's values, so its content is purely logic.

clue.text: Note interval in rank above bronze- medal position

indicators.note: in a down clue, above puts the first piece over the second

parts.note: major is a military rank
the bronze medal goes to whoever finishes third

explanation.surface: An army officer finishes ahead of the bronze medallist.
explanation.definitionFit: A major third is the musical interval of four semitones between two notes.

clue.text: Lie — see you cheat

parts.note: ta-ra is an informal northern English goodbye, like see you
to diddle is to swindle or cheat

explanation.surface: A liar says goodbye and goes off to cheat someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A taradiddle is a petty falsehood or fib.

clue.text: Keep out of this Indian state following denial? Not quite true

indicators.note: following places the pieces after the denial

parts.note: no is a denial
Goa is a state on India's west coast

indicators.note: not quite means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: real means true or genuine

explanation.surface: Someone is warned off visiting an Indian state, after a denial that rings false.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-go area is a district people are advised or forbidden to enter.

clue.text: Got caught tendon? Too bad

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: bad means faulty, so these letters come out wrongly ordered

explanation.surface: An athlete pulled a tendon, which is too bad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' turns TENDONTOO into OTTONEDON after C.
explanation.definitionFit: To cotton on is to grasp or understand, just as 'got it' means understood.

clue.text: Decides game's mostly inferior

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game

indicators.note: mostly means all but the final letter

parts.note: less can mean lower in rank, inferior

explanation.surface: Someone judges that a match is largely second-rate.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge rules on a case, meaning decides it officially.

clue.text: Stirs up Republican fires

parts.note: to fire someone is to oust them from a job

explanation.surface: A Republican sacks people and stirs up trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To roust is to rouse or drive someone out, so to stir up.

clue.text: Dash of ketchup in most recent pancake

indicators.note: in places the letter inside the other piece

parts.note: late can mean most recent, as in the late news

indicators.note: a dash is a tiny amount, so only the first letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: A splash of ketchup goes on the latest pancake.
explanation.definitionFit: A latke is a Jewish potato pancake, often eaten at Hanukkah.

clue.text: Calling on mobile phone provider in shop

indicators.note: in places the provider inside the other piece

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing on someone, as to shop them is
EE is a British mobile phone network

explanation.surface: Someone telephones while in a mobile phone shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shop' is the British slang verb for informing on someone, not a store. EE is a UK mobile network.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing someone can mean visiting them, as in calling on a friend.

clue.text: Upon retirement, gift bond for delivery worker

indicators.note: retirement is withdrawal, a going back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a sop is a small gift to placate someone
a tie is a bond

explanation.surface: A retiring worker receives a gift and a savings bond.
explanation.walkthrough: POSTIE is informal British for a postman.
explanation.definitionFit: A postie is a postal worker who delivers mail.

clue.text: Attempt bets, just evens for example

indicators.note: only the even-numbered letters of the word are taken

parts.note: say introduces an example, as for example does

explanation.surface: A gambler tries placing bets only at even money.
explanation.definitionFit: An essay is an attempt or try, its original sense.

clue.text: Outline of hotel suite rejigged

indicators.note: rejigged means rearranged, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A hotel suite has been rearranged, and here is its floor plan.
explanation.definitionFit: A silhouette is the dark shape or outline of something against light.

clue.text: Enigma Variation concerning a number of conductors?

parts.note: re means concerning or about
a bus is a set of electrical conductors, and also a numbered vehicle with a conductor

explanation.surface: Elgar's Enigma Variations, which many orchestra conductors have taken on.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface points to Elgar, but 'Enigma Variation' means a kind of puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebus is a puzzle using pictures or symbols for words, one type of enigma.

clue.text: African flag sent back by cause so abandoned

indicators.note: sent back means turned round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: to flag is to tire

indicators.note: abandoned means the letters of the next word are dropped from the other

parts.note: reason means cause

explanation.surface: An African flag is returned because its cause was given up.
explanation.definitionFit: An Eritrean is a person from Eritrea, a country in the Horn of Africa.

clue.text: This may follow first film shot with sound technology on vacation

definitions.text: This may follow first film shot

parts.note: safe and sound both mean secure or unharmed

indicators.note: the word's middle has been vacated, leaving only its outer letters

explanation.surface: A film shoot pairs good sound with absent technology.
explanation.walkthrough: Safety first, safety film and safety shot all start with the answer, so 'follow' should be 'precede', as the setter confirmed on the blog.
explanation.definitionFit: Safety combines in phrases with first, film and shot, each naming a careful or protective thing.
